stories.title: How AI is speeding new business creation, especially among Gen Z entrepreneurs
stories.summary: Entrepreneurs are turning to AI to speed the creation of new businesses, with Gen Z leading the way. That's according to a new report from the payroll software firm Gusto.

stories.title: Eyes are on the Supreme Court for another abortion pill ruling
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has just made its next move on access to the abortion pill mifepristone.

stories.title: Lebanese start to go hungry as wars take their toll
stories.summary: In Lebanon, hunger is spreading as war causes shortages and price increases.

stories.title: This week in science: Sunscreen from fish, art and aging, and a sustainable marimba
stories.summary: NPR's science podcast Short Wave brings us the stories of how future sunscreens might come from fish, how loving art may impact aging, and a student's quest to build a more sustainable marimba.

stories.title: Trump and Xi make nice in China. What's it mean for the future?
stories.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with China correspondent Jennifer Pak and White House correspondent Franco Ordonez about the relationship between President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

stories.title: Weezer and Beyoncé are among new National Recording Registry entries
stories.summary: Weezer, Beyoncé, The Go-Go's and music from the video game Doom join the National Recording Registry at the Library of Congress.
